summary: Podgrab is a self-hosted podcast manager that downloads episodes and has a built-in player. No sign-in needed. Saved 5 views: (1) podcasts-home (/): subscribed podcasts in list layout with cover art, episode counts, tags and action buttons, plus sort/filter/layout dropdowns. (2) all-episodes (/episodes + clicking "Show Filters"): 997 episodes with the filter panel open (search, sort, page size, podcasts, tags, played/downloaded). (3) player (/player): audio player with cover art, playback controls and a playlist. (4) settings (/settings): preferences form, disk stats, and Backups/OPML/RSS buttons. (5) add-podcast-search (/add + an iTunes search for "podcast"): RSS URL field, OPML import and search result cards. The podcast detail page (/podcasts/<id>/view) is skipped because its episode list looks almost the same as All Episodes. I also didn't capture the Tags and Backups pages.
